description: Hard deposits made of minerals and salts that form inside your kidneys.
causes: Dehydration, certain diets, obesity, and some medical conditions.
symptoms: Severe pain in the side and back
Pain that radiates to the lower abdomen and groin
prevention: Drink plenty of water and limit salt/animal protein.
treatment_action: Pain relievers, drinking water, or medical procedures (lithotripsy).

description: A condition that causes inflammation in the walls of medium-sized arteries throughout the body, including the coronary arteries.
causes: Unknown, but thought to be an immune response to an infection.
treatment_action: Gamma globulin and aspirin (under medical supervision).
complications: Heart artery aneurysms and heart valve problems.

description: An exaggerated, forward rounding of the back.
causes: Osteoporosis, disc degeneration, or birth defects.
prevention: Maintain good posture and treat osteoporosis.
treatment_action: Physical therapy, braces, or surgery in severe cases.
complications: Physical disfigurement, back pain, and breathing difficulties.
